title: The Value of Logistic Flexibility in E-commerce
eligible_reason: Reported design is a near/far difference-in-differences around pickup-station openings: felm(GMV ~ After + Station*After | town_id + year_week + week_day). The post-opening indicator After (Days >= 0, days relative to the nearest newly opened station) is defined for treated AND control locations and enters as a separate unit-specific time-varying regressor next to the treatment Station x After, which the protocol excludes (additional treatment / time-varying regressor). Fixed effects are at the town (area) level rather than the location level, and the day-of-week FE is a nonredundant additive FE. Independently, the README states that all shipped data are synthetic, and the files in synthetic_data/ are Git LFS pointer stubs (127-134 bytes each), so no analysis data are actually present.
design_notes: Location-day panel (Bai2025_agg_synthetic_data.rda: location_id, year_week, week_day, Days, distance, town_id, GMV, Items_value, Orders, Newcomers). Station = 1 if distance to nearest newly opened station <= 0.4 km (treated), control = farther locations within an observation radius (0.65-0.80 km in robustness). After = 1 if Days >= 0. Table 2: four outcomes (GMV, Items_value, Orders, Newcomers), coefficient on After:Station, FE town_id + year_week + week_day, lfe::felm default (non-clustered) SEs. Parallel-trend test: Days + Days*Station on pre-period rows. Robustness: treatment radius 0.25-0.40 km and observation radius 0.65-0.80 km (Figures 2-3). Hundreds of station openings at different dates (abstract), so the underlying variation is staggered in principle, but cohorts cannot be verified from the package.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Unknown; station openings occur on many dates (abstract: hundreds of stations) but the data cannot be read (LFS pointers).
never_treated_note: Locations beyond the 0.4 km treatment radius never have Station x After = 1, but they still receive an After switch at their nearest station's opening.

near_miss_specs.exclusion_reason: separate After regressor; town-level not location FE; week_day FE; synthetic data not shipped

data_files: synthetic_data/Bai2025_agg_synthetic_data.rda (Git LFS pointer, 133 bytes; real size 27.2 MB)
synthetic_data/customer_*.csv/.pickle, gaussian_params.csv, prob_slot.csv, station_coordinates_perturbed.csv (all LFS pointers; structural model inputs)
screener_notes: README: actual data under NDA; synthetic data 'mimic key statistical properties' and 'exact numerical outputs may differ'. Package archive was downloaded as a ZIP so the LFS-tracked data files are stubs; cloning the GitHub repo with git-lfs would retrieve the synthetic files only. Even with data, the reported specification is not a clean staggered TWFE because of the After main effect and town-level FE. Not worth pursuing.
